warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.intro: Choose an action, then scan each unit. Stock changes only after a confirmed scan.
warehouse.choose: Select one of your authorised actions above. Contact an admin if no actions are available.
warehouse.cameraError: Camera unavailable. Allow camera access on HTTPS, or use a USB scanner.
warehouse.offline: You are offline. Reconnect before scanning. No stock was changed.
warehouse.staffHelp: Choose a registered, email-verified employee. Grant only the warehouse actions they need. These permissions never grant admin access.
warehouse.revokeHelp: Uncheck every permission and save to revoke warehouse access.
warehouse.activationWarning: Opening count required: current stock is {{count}}. Enabling QR tracking sets online availability to zero until each physical unit is labelled and received. Active orders and payment holds must be resolved first.
warehouse.activationAck: I have prepared an opening count and understand stock will be rebuilt from scans.
warehouse.labelsHelp: Each label identifies one physical unit of this exact variant. Printing creates expected units only; scan Receive to add stock.
warehouse.labelError: Could not generate QR labels. Reload the batch and retry.

help.receive: Attach its label, then scan once to add this unit to stock.
help.dispatch: Pack matching units first. Scan again in carrier-handoff mode when they leave the warehouse. Stock is already reserved by checkout.
help.return: Returned units go into quarantine. They cannot be sold until inspection passes. A return scan does not issue a refund.
help.inspect: Check the physical unit before selecting Pass or Reject. Cancelled-order units must be scanned into inspection first.
help.sell: Only unreserved units can be sold. Enter the receipt reference before scanning. This records stock movement; it does not collect payment.

warehouse.noBlockers: No active orders or payment reservations found.
warehouse.blockersHelp: These records still contain this product. Review each order and correct its status only after confirming what actually happened. Zero available stock does not mean there are no outstanding orders.
warehouse.pendingOrderHelp: Payment is still pending. Verify the payment record before changing this order; it may require reconciliation.
warehouse.holdsHelp: Payment reservations must be reconciled with the payment provider before release. Age alone does not prove a payment failed.

billing.title: Invoice details
billing.intro: Choose who is buying so we can record the correct invoice recipient.
billing.authorityHelp: Enter the invoice reference and submission requirements supplied by your authority. Portal submission is handled separately; an email copy is not proof of portal delivery.
billing.portalInstructions: Portal name and submission instructions (no passwords)
billing.sameAsShipping: Billing address is the same as the delivery address
billing.consent: I agree to receive invoices electronically at the email address entered for this order. Contact us before ordering if you need another delivery method.
billing.invalid: Please complete the required billing fields and confirm electronic delivery.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Branded PDF and validated XRechnung records, linked to each paid order.
invoices.saved: Saved. The invoice worker processes queued documents.
invoices.reportingNote: Periods use Berlin calendar dates (weeks start Monday). Advance and final invoices describe the same sale: do not add both as revenue. Credit notes are positive credit amounts to subtract. CSV includes full invoice totals and separate matching-product net totals. Queue entries without an issue date appear under All. This is an invoice register, not a tax return.
invoices.empty: No invoices in this selection. New paid orders are queued automatically after setup.
invoices.portalPending: Portal submission required — email is a customer copy only
invoices.supplyHelp: Enter the actual tax-relevant supply date from the shipment records. The final invoice offsets the paid advance invoice.
invoices.correctionNote: Creates an immutable credit note for the entire invoice. This does not refund the payment or change stock. For partial returns, arrange a partial correction with your accountant; do not use a full cancellation.
invoices.portalHelp: Record the receipt reference only after the authority portal accepted the invoice.

finance.foundationManualLedgerAndAccessControlsS: In development: ledger, original documents and reviewed operating expenses. Automatic store accounting, complete financial statements and tax reports are not enabled yet.
finance.noJournalsYetNoTestDataOrHistoricOrdersH: No journals yet. No test data or historic orders have been imported.
finance.debitsAndCreditsMustBalancePostedEntries: Debits and credits must balance. Posted entries can only be reversed.
finance.reasonForReversalPeriodChangeMin5Charact: Reason for reversal / period change (min. 5 characters)
finance.existingSupabaseUserIdThisRoleDoesNotGra: Existing Supabase user ID. This role does not grant store-admin or warehouse access.
finance.title: Finance

financeDocs.title: Documents & expenses
financeDocs.scope: Preserve and review original evidence. The expense workflow currently supports ordinary domestic operating expenses in EUR with non-deductible input VAT. Inventory, fixed assets, imports and reverse charge need separate workflows.
financeDocs.drop: Drop files here or choose files
financeDocs.fileLimit: PDF, PNG, JPEG or UTF-8 XML. Maximum 3 MB per file.
financeDocs.search: Search filename, supplier or invoice number
financeDocs.retryUpload: Upload incomplete — upload the same file again
financeDocs.immutable: This review is immutable. Posted entries can be reversed in the ledger. Any recorded payments must also be reviewed.
financeDocs.manualReview: Complete fields against the original. No automatic OCR or e-invoice validation. Changes are saved as a new review.
financeDocs.confirmDomestic: I reviewed the original: ordinary domestic operating expense in EUR, no inventory or fixed assets, no deductible input VAT and no reverse charge.
financeDocs.paymentOnly: This records a payment that has already happened. No money is transferred. Partial payments are supported.
financeDocs.confirmPayment: The selected evidence supports this amount and date. This payment has not already been recorded.
financeDocs.saveChangesFirst: Save changed fields as a new review first, then open that review to post it.

financeReports.title: Financial overview
financeReports.provisional: Provisional internal report from posted entries. Without verified opening balances, complete store postings, inventory valuation and bank reconciliation these figures are incomplete. Not an EÜR, tax return or statutory balance sheet. Bank and cash are book balances, not confirmed available funds. Cash movements are not yet classified into operating, investing and financing activities.

financeSales.title: Store accounting inbox
financeSales.scope: Newly issued shop invoices are automatically collected for review. Import records verified §19 EUR advances as provider clearing against customer advances, not revenue yet. No EÜR classification or bank settlement. Unpaid orders are not posted.
financeSales.rescan: Collect existing issued invoices for review
financeSales.empty: No invoice events yet. The invoice worker must have issued invoices.
financeSales.confirm: I reviewed the invoice, payment and date. This is a real customer payment, not a test order, and has not been posted manually.
financeSales.manual: Final invoices and credits still need separate accounting review. Do not import them again as payments.
